scope_limits: Thoppil et al. (2025), DOI 10.1016/j.pocean.2025.103529, explicitly reports an approximately 550 km zonal extent on 24 February 2020 before near-splitting by 23 March. Original NOAA-hosted published PDF reviewed.

Source support is a weekly ensemble-mean verifying analysis from the NCOM/NCODA/COAMPS system. Calling analysis truth for forecast verification does not make it a direct observation or a forecast-member scalar.
This is a zonal parent extent with unspecified scalar boundary threshold and uncertainty. No principal width, diameter, annual envelope, physical polygon or child values inferred.
The 120 km deep-cyclone diameter and 150 km cyclone zonal extent describe other features and are excluded from Thor.
